# Ambrose Kerr

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly fifty years old in volume 4; around sixty-three in volume 5  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032)</sub>

## Appearance

For around fifteen years, Ambrose made himself look like a side-show oddity by refusing to trim his hair or shave his face, leaving him with very long iron-gray hair down to his shoulders and a lengthy beard that gave him the appearance of an ancient Viking. After his political party won power, he shaved off his beard and trimmed his hair. He is a very large man possessing the physical strength of an ox.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P31](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0031), [v5 c9 P14](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0014)_

## Personality

Ambrose is clever, sharp, widely read, and exceptionally grand, with a heart that is twinkly, hearty, and big. He is a steadfast Grit in politics and a dedicated Presbyterian, possessing an absolute resolve and obstinacy once he makes a commitment. Though he has a quick temper, he relishes jokes, rarely takes things too seriously, and loves sharing entertaining stories, singing Scottish ballads, and dancing. He feels deep compassion and outrage over mistreated children and holds a strong fondness for kids and young people.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c37 P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017), [v4 c37 P20](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0020), [v5 c8 P4](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0004), [v5 c8 P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 c9 P14](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0014), [v5 c9 P39](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0039), [v5 c26 P11](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0011), [v5 c27 P6](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0006)_

## History

Ambrose Kerr grew up near Seven Gulls and engaged fiercely in politics as a Liberal partisan. During a bitter general election fifteen years prior to volume 4, he swore publicly that he would not cut his hair or shave his face until the Grits took power. True to his word, he allowed his hair and beard to grow wild for a decade and a half. During this time, he spent his days cod-fishing with Captain Saul, engaging in lively discussions, and entertaining friends like Lorna Ainslie and Nell Harcourt with his stories, tenor ballad singing, and skill at dancing. When the Liberals finally won the election, Ambrose immediately walked to Augustus Palmer's barber shop after midnight and compelled the barber to give him a full haircut and shave. Soon after, he married Miss Winifred Tolley and moved into her home located between the Glen and Seven Gulls Point, surrounding it with planted trees, a spruce hedge, and a rose garden. When he heard of the mistreatment suffered by the orphan Mary Stubbs, his outrage prompted him to investigate the matter across the harbor, and he readily agreed with his wife to adopt Mary into their home.
